# Writing Sprint

State the text's core insight in one sentence. Rebuild the text around that sentence with a technique taken from a passage you have just read by another writer, in place of your default habits.

- Find the passage by the writer to channel, or by craft move in home's [`projects/skill-lab/moves.md`](https://github.com/mehrlander/home/blob/main/projects/skill-lab/moves.md), which files passages under the technique each shows. Add a new writer's passage as that file says.

- Take the passage's technique and shape, not its subject.
- Keep the rebuild only if it reads stronger than the original.
